subject: Future Tech
title: Nano in Food and Packaging
description: A quick, practical guide to Nano in Food and Packaging.

hook.text: Nano-silver in food containers kills bacteria. Nano-clay in packaging blocks oxygen.

buildup.text: Nano-sized additives in packaging films are invisible but functional.

discovery.text: Nano-sensors embedded in packaging change color when food spoils.

twist.text: Nano-titanium dioxide whitened food (E171) in candies and sauces until the EU banned it in 2022 over safety concerns.

climax.text: Nano food packaging could reduce the 1.3 billion tons of food wasted annually.

punchline.text: Invisible tech keeping your food visible on the shelf longer.

quiz.question: Why was nano-titanium dioxide (E171) banned in the EU?
